about: Measured small-moon shapes (src/moons/shapes.ts): Cassini frames reproduced from their PDS geometry (Thomas et al. 2018 shape-model documents, Table 1: image SCLK, sub-spacecraft lat / W lon, range, sub-solar W lon) + generic views of every reshaped moon on 2026-11-08 12:00 UTC. All shots share one page; the first defines window.__mv(o): o.sclk -> UTC (SCLK s since 1958-01-01), time calibrated so the app's sub-solar W longitude equals o.sunLonW, camera at body lat/lonW (or azFromSun/el in the moon-up frame), o.distKm, o.fovDeg (bypasses the 20 deg UI minimum). Usage: node scripts/shots.mjs scripts/test/specs/moon-shapes.json <outDir>

shots.name: pan-pia21436-left-N1867604669
shots.eval: (() => { window.__mv = async (o) => { const sv = window.__sv, D = Math.PI / 180; const frames = (n) => new Promise((r) => { let k = 0; const st = () => (++k >= n ? r() : requestAnimationFrame(st)); requestAnimationFrame(st); }); const moon = () => sv.frame.moons.find((x) => x.name.toLowerCase() === o.moon); const wrap = (x) => ((x % 360) + 360) % 360; const sub = () => { const m = moon(); const s = sv.frame.sunDir.clone().applyQuaternion(m.orient.clone().invert()); return [Math.asin(s.z) / D, wrap(-Math.atan2(s.y, s.x) / D)]; }; let t = o.sclk ? Date.UTC(1958, 0, 1) + o.sclk * 1000 : Date.parse(o.t); sv.setTime(new Date(t).toISOString()); await frames(3); if (o.sunLonW !== undefined) { const m = moon(); const n = m.pos.clone().cross(m.vel).length() / m.pos.lengthSq() / D; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const d = wrap(o.sunLonW - sub()[1] + 180) - 180; t += (d / n) * 1000; sv.setTime(new Date(t).toISOString()); await frames(3); } } sv.app.settings.fovDeg = o.fovDeg ?? 40; const m = moon(); const V = m.pos.constructor; const z = new V(0, 0, 1).applyQuaternion(m.orient).normalize(); const x = new V(1, 0, 0).addScaledVector(z, -z.x).normalize(); const y = new V().crossVectors(z, x); const c = sv.camera.active; c.target = o.moon; if (o.lat !== undefined) { const la = o.lat * D, lo = -o.lonW * D; const d = new V(Math.cos(la) * Math.cos(lo), Math.cos(la) * Math.sin(lo), Math.sin(la)).applyQuaternion(m.orient); c.az = Math.atan2(d.dot(y), d.dot(x)); c.el = Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, d.dot(z)))); } else { const s = sv.frame.sunDir; c.az = Math.atan2(s.dot(y), s.dot(x)) + o.azFromSun * D; c.el = o.el * D; } c.dist = o.distKm * 1e3; await frames(4); const ss = sub(); return o.moon + ' ' + new Date(t).toISOString() + ' subsolar ' + ss[0].toFixed(2) + 'N ' + ss[1].toFixed(2) + 'W fov ' + sv.app.settings.fovDeg; }; return window.__mv({ moon: 'pan', sclk: 1867604669, sunLonW: 199.29, lat: 39.21, lonW: 216.71, distKm: 24541.8, fovDeg: 0.17 }); })()
